# Flows and ports

Every connection ReliKey allows. Only the bastion reaches the legacy zone, and the legacy system reaches only the facade (decision 0002); the core never connects into an edge (decision 0005). A loopback flow stays on one host.

| id | from | to | protocol | port | scope | purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| F-01 | person | front | https | 443 | network | Sign-in at the broker with a passkey; step-up and approval sign-ins (the broker's hostname on the front). |
| F-02 | person | front | https | 443 | network | The KeyClerk desk - requests, approvals, the one-time hand-over of a lease credential (the desk's hostname on the front). |
| F-03 | person | bastion | ssh, mysql, postgres, rdp | 2222, 33306, 55432, 3389 | network | Non-HTTP sessions to targets; Warpgate sign-in is OIDC against the broker. |
| F-03b | person | proxy | https | 443 | network | Web sign-in, web SSH and RDP, and HTTPS targets; the proxy refuses Warpgate's admin paths under /@warpgate and /_warpgate (decision 0008). |
| F-03c | proxy | bastion | https | 8888 | loopback | Everything but the admin paths, to Warpgate on the edge's loopback. |
| F-04 | bastion | front | https | 443 | network | OIDC code exchange and keys for bastion sign-in, at the broker's hostname (edge to core, outbound). |
| F-05 | clerk | broker | http | 8080 | loopback | Admin and SCIM API (reconciler), OIDC for desk sign-in and approval proofs (core internal; KeyClerk takes plain http to loopback only). |
| F-06 | agent | front | https | 443 | network | Pull signed lease bundles, report applied state and drift, deliver one-time lease credentials (edge to core; the edge-facing hostname, which serves the desk's edge routes only). |
| F-07 | agent | bastion | https | 8888 | loopback | Warpgate admin API on the edge host only - role assignments with expiry, session approvals (C-01, C-02). |
| F-08 | agent | facade | https | 17170 | loopback | Set and rotate lease credentials through the facade's admin API (lldap http_host on loopback; C-03). Never over the LDAP port the legacy system binds to (the model check refuses a shared port). |
| F-09 | bastion | org-store | https | 443 | network | Upload session recordings as they happen (Warpgate object storage); the edge keeps a sized local store for what it cannot deliver (decision 0009). |
| F-10 | bastion | legacy | ssh, rdp, vnc, mysql, postgres, https | per-target | network | The only interactive path into the legacy system; recorded. |
| F-11 | legacy | facade | ldaps, ldap | 6360, 3890 | network | The legacy system's own LDAP bind and search. Plain LDAP only on the isolated legacy link (R-04). |
| F-12 | broker | org-idp | https | 443 | network | Optional brokering to the organisation's IdP. |
| F-13 | clerk | org-store | https, syslog-tls | 443, 6514 | network | Export of audit events and evidence (required with the evidence store, decision 0009). |
| F-14 | clerk | vault | https | 8200 | network | Optional core secret store for target credentials (core internal). |
| F-15 | person | legacy | local-panel | none | network | A person at the machine's own panel (HMI) signing in with a lease credential; the panel binds to the facade (P-D). |
| F-16 | person | bastion | ssh | 2222 | local-port | The local access window (decision 0009) - Warpgate SSH only, never HTTP. |
| F-17 | person | agent | ssh | 2223 | local-port | Presenting a carried visit lease to the agent during the local access window (C-07). |
| F-18 | host | front | https | 443 | network | Pull images and the signed update manifest from the core's mirror (edge to core, outbound; C-11; the edge-facing hostname, read methods only). |
| F-19 | host | org-time | nts, ntp, dns | 4460, 123, 53 | network | Authenticated time and name resolution while online (decision 0007 point 4). |
| F-20 | clerk | org-escrow | https | 443 | network | Hand break-glass ciphertexts (two custodians) to the escrow and record its acknowledgement (decision 0008). |
| F-21 | agent | org-store | https | 443 | network | Backfill recordings the bastion could not deliver, with their hashes in the chained edge log (C-12). |
| F-22 | front | broker | http | 8080 | loopback | Sign-in, OIDC endpoints and keys under the realm (public hostname); the admin console only from the host-loopback listener. |
| F-23 | front | clerk | http | 8091 | loopback | The desk and its API (desk hostname); the edge routes /api/v1/edge/* and /api/v1/edge-key (edge hostname). |
| F-24 | front | mirror | http | 5000 | loopback | The mirror's read API (GET and HEAD under /v2/) on the edge hostname; nothing writes through the front. |
| F-25 | broker | broker-db | postgres | 5432 | loopback | Keycloak's own database. |
| F-26 | broker | clerk | http | 8091 | loopback | Back-channel logout - the broker tells the desk a session ended (KeyClerk decision 0007). |
| F-27 | agent | front | https | 443 | network | The edge's signed fleet report (decision 0026) - release, applied serial, drift, profile, link crypto - on the edge-facing name, which routes it to the fleet service; outbound from the edge only. |
| F-28 | front | fleet | http | 8093 | loopback | The front hands the fleet routes of the edge-facing name to the fleet service. |
